user_journeys.description: User browses Unsplash for wallpapers and clicks on one.
user_journeys.business_value: Engaging users with content, driving traffic to image pages.

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: Unsplash Wallpaper Click (1) -- Partial
proposed_scenarios.description: Test scenario covering the initial navigation to Unsplash homepage, which was the only step completed before a hard blocker.
proposed_scenarios.workflow_narrative: The user intended to find and click on a wallpaper on Unsplash. The agent successfully navigated to the Unsplash homepage but encountered a hard blocker immediately after, preventing any further interaction or completion of the goal.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify initial access to the Unsplash homepage.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a user, I want to navigate to Unsplash to start browsing for wallpapers, but the flow was blocked after initial navigation.

detailed_steps.verification_point: Unsplash homepage is loaded and visible.
detailed_steps.business_impact: Ensures basic site accessibility and availability.

expected_results: User successfully navigates to the Unsplash homepage.
Workflow is blocked after initial navigation.
prerequisites: Unsplash website is online and accessible.
